subject: hiredis library required for RcppRedis to deploy

messages.author: 5b7b216615fd9b53
messages.subject: hiredis library required for RcppRedis to deploy
parts:
I have coded a shiny app that runs perfectly locally but when I try yo deploy it to shinyapps.io I have configuration issures with RcppRedis because RcppRedis needs the hiredis library. The exact error message is

checking for hiredis/hiredis.h... no
configure: WARNING: Hiredis headers not found with via default CXXFLAGS and CPPFLAGS, trying /usr/local/include
configure: WARNING: Unsetting ac_cv_header_hiredis_hiredis_h
checking hiredis/hiredis.h usability... no
checking hiredis/hiredis.h presence... no
checking for hiredis/hiredis.h... no
configure: error: ERROR: hiredis headers required; use '-Iincludedir' in CXXFLAGS for unusual locations.
ERROR: configuration failed for package ‘RcppRedis’

The Github page for RcppRedis suggests downloading hiredis from Debian ( https://packages.debian.org/sid/libhiredis-dev). I am enthusiastic but inexperienced when it comes to deploying apps and sadly I do not know how to download hiredis from Debian to make my app work.

Could anyone enlighten me in fairly simple terms?

I would really appreciate any help!

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: hiredis library required for RcppRedis to deploy
parts: The user guide covers this here. You will want to open an issue, or better yet contribute a pull request, so that the system dependency can be installed.
